model: Simple Glide Fat Tire 750W Recumbent E Trike w/ Footrest & Hitch Connector
description:
The 2026 Simple Glide isn’t just an electric trike—it’s a movement toward freedom, dignity, and independence for seniors and riders with mobility challenges. Designed with comfort and accessibility at its core, this next-generation e-trike transforms everyday movement into effortless adventure. Now featuring a modular rear hitch and subframe system, riders can easily attach a cargo basket or passenger seat, opening up new possibilities for carrying essentials, assisting a partner, or simply enjoying the ride together.

Whether you’re picking up groceries, taking your grandchild for a spin, or cruising your neighborhood trails, the Simple Glide gives you the power to ride your way—with confidence, safety, and total control.

Senior-Friendly Features — Comfort Meets Capability

Low Step-Through Frame: Designed for easy mounting and dismounting, especially for those with limited flexibility or balance concerns.

Ergonomic Recumbent-Style Seat: High-back design with armrests supports the entire body, reducing pressure on the hips and back during long rides.

Effortless Adjustability: Quick-release seat and handlebar adjustment system helps every rider find their perfect, pain-free position in seconds.

Integrated Footrest: Rest and relax mid-ride by folding down the footrest—perfect for seniors wanting to use throttle-only mode or take a break from pedaling.

Enhanced Utility and Independence — New for 2026

Modular Rear Utility System: The new rear hitch ball mount allows for quick attachment of a cargo basket or passenger seat, great for carrying groceries, mobility aids, or a loved one.

Tool-Free Removal: Install or detach the utility system with ease—ideal for seniors seeking adaptability without complexity.

Built for Stability: The extended wheelbase and 4-inch fat tires deliver smooth, confident handling, even on uneven terrain.

Power You Can Depend On

750W Quiet Motor: Provides safe, steady power with 5 levels of pedal assist or full-throttle riding—ideal for seniors who prefer variable support or limited pedaling.

48V 15Ah Battery: Up to 50 miles of range per charge means fewer stops and more exploring.

UL 2271 Certified Battery (Tested by ACT Labs): Ensures dependable safety and reliable performance.

350 lb Weight Capacity: Built strong to accommodate riders, cargo, or adaptive attachments.

Designed for Everyday Ease

Compact Folding Frame: Store or transport the trike effortlessly—perfect for downsized living spaces, RVs, or travel.

Smooth, Stable Ride: Low center of gravity keeps the trike balanced, reducing tipping risks and increasing rider confidence.

The 2026 Simple Glide delivers the ultimate combination of comfort, safety, and independence for seniors. Whether you’re staying active, exploring local paths, or maintaining mobility with ease, it’s the most adaptive, senior-friendly e-trike ever built—because every rider deserves the freedom to glide simple and glide far.

The advanced rear differential on this 3 wheel ebike ensures power is distributed evenly to both rear wheels when pedaling. Turns on this e trike are smooth as butter and balanced. Both wheels in the rear will be getting power gluing the wheels to ground with unbelievable traction. Ultimately making turns on this 3 wheeled electric bike incredible safe and stable.

State-of-the-Art Rear Differential that Stabilizes the Rear Wheels and Creates a Safe Balanced Ride

Take Turns Knowing the Traction Will be Amazing Around Corners

All Three Tires Stayed Glued to Riding Surface

Ride Through Grass and Trails Easily with Both Rear Wheels Receiving Power
